data.body: [P1] `AfterInvocationCompleted` and the `$absent` control below require core-runner behavior added by this PR, but the OTel package metadata and `OtelExtension.requires_core` still accept core 1.0.0. Since the distributions are independently versioned, that valid installation ignores this gate and treats `$absent` as literal event data, causing incorrect timing or unconditional failures in cases 25–26. Raise both lower bounds to the core release containing these controls and test the installed OTel wheel against its declared minimum core version.
